paite: Alal lai hun in Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in huai gam ahong dou a, Jehoiakim bel asikha in kum thum a-om hi. Huai nung in alehngatsan a, atung ah ahelta hi.
english: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant for three years. Then he turned and rebelled against him.

paite: TOUPA'N Kaldai pawlte, Siria pawlte, Moab pawlte, Ammon suan pawlte amah sual ding in asawlkhia a, asikha zawlneite zang a agen TOUPA thu bang in Judah gam hihsesak ding in asawl hi.
english: Yahweh sent against him bands of the Chaldeans, bands of the Syrians, bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to Yahweh’s word which he spoke by his servants the prophets.

paite: Manasseh khelhna, athilhih tengteng ziak a, amuh phaklouhna a amaute suanmang ding in, Judah tung ah TOUPA thupiak ahong tung petmah hi.
english: Surely at the commandment of Yahweh this came on Judah, to remove them out of his sight for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did,

paite: Midik sisan asuah ziak in leng; midik sisan a Jerusalem ahihdim ziak in leng TOUPA'N amah angaidam kei hi.
english: and also for the innocent blood that he shed; for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and Yahweh would not pardon.

paite: Huchi in Jehoiakim tanchin dang leh athilhih tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah tuang ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

paite: Huchi in Jehoiakim bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a; asik in atapa Jehoiakin alalta hi.
english: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers, and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.

paite: Aigupta kumpipa agam a pan ahong kuankhe nawn kei; Babulon kumpipa'n Aigupta gam lui a pan Euphrates Luipi pha a kumpipa gam huap tengteng alak zoh tak ziak in.
english: The king of Egypt didn’t come out of his land any more; for the king of Babylon had taken, from the brook of Egypt to the river Euphrates, all that belonged to the king of Egypt.

paite: Jehoiakin bel alal pat tung in kum sawm-le-giat a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kha thum alal a, anu min Nehushta, Jerusalem a Elnathan tanu ahi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Jehoiakin / (2 Kro 36.9,10)
english: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Nehushta the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

paite: Apa hihdan tengteng hih in, TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that his father had done.

paite: Huchih lai in Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar sikhate Jerusalem ah ahohtou ua, khua ava um uhi.
english: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up to Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.

paite: Huchi a asikhate'n ava um lai un khua ah Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar ava hohtou hi,
english: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to the city while his servants were besieging it,

paite: Huchi in Judah kumpipa Jehoiakin, anu, asikhate, amiliante, aheutute toh Babulon kumpipa kiang ah ava pawtkhia ua; alal akum giatna kum in Babulon kumpipa'n ana man hi.
english: and Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon—he, his mother, his servants, his princes, and his officers; and the king of Babylon captured him in the eighth year of his reign.

paite: TOUPA gen bang in, a-inn a gou tengteng leh kumpipa' inn a gou tengteng ala vek a, TOUPA tempul a Israelte kumpipa Solomon in dangka-eng tui-um belsuan abawl tengteng asatgawp vek hi.
english: He carried out from there all the treasures of Yahweh’s house and the treasures of the king’s house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in Yahweh’s temple, as Yahweh had said.

paite: Jerusalem a mi tengteng, milian tengteng, mihat hangsan hoih tengteng, singkhat leh khutsiam leh siksekmi tengteng sal in api vek hi. Huai gam a migentheite chih louh kuamah a-omta kei uhi.
english: He carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valor, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and the smiths. No one remained except the poorest people of the land.

paite: Jehoiakin bel Babulon ah api a; kumpipa nu, kumpinute, aheutute leh huai gam a mihatte Jerusalem a pan Babulon ah sal in api hi.
english: He carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, with the king’s mother, the king’s wives, his officers, and the chief men of the land. He carried them into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.

paite: Babulon kumpipa'n pasal hoih tengteng sangsagih leh khutsiam leh siksekmi sangkhat, mihat hoih teng gal dou thei mi ngen Babulon ah sal in api vek hi.
english: All the men of might, even seven thousand, and the craftsmen and the smiths one thousand, all of them strong and fit for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.

paite: Apa unaupa Mattaniah, Babulon kumpipa'n asik in alalsak a, amin Zedekiah chi in akheksak hi.
english: The king of Babylon made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s father’s brother, king in his place, and changed his name to Zedekiah.

paite: Zedekiah bel alal pat tung in kum sawmnih-le-khat a upa ahi. Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-khat sung alal a; anu min Hamutal, Libnah a Jeremiah tanu ahi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Zedekiah / (2 Kro 36.11,12; Jer 52.1-3)
english: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

paite: Jehoiakim hihdan tengteng bang in ahih a, TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

paite: TOUPA hehna tawn in Jerusalem leh Judah tung ah Zedekiah, Babulon kumpipa tung a ahel a pan ama'n amuh phak louh dia apaihmang masiah hiai thilte ahong tungta hi.
english: For through the anger of Yahweh, this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence. Then Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
